name: baton
question: What if every task went to the cheapest model that could actually finish it?
body: An orchestrator of orchestrators, routed by what it costs. Say what you want and it picks a mode, plans a graph, and sends every task to the cheapest rung that can finish it — escalating one rung at a time, asking before it spends the expensive one, and handing you a one-slide brief at each decision instead of a report to dig through.
alt: baton — six rungs of model × effort, a task graph routed to the cheapest rung that can finish it
